info.title: Transaction Ledger API
info.description:
Accounts, idempotent credit/debit transactions, paginated history and atomic transfers.

**Try it:** create an account, copy its `id`, then post transactions and read the balance and history.

All amounts are in major currency units (₹) with at most 2 decimal places. Every error uses the same envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details }, request_id }`.

post.description: Creates an account with a zero balance. The client cannot set the balance.

schema.description: Only `name` is accepted. `id`, `balance` and `created_at` are system-generated.

requestBody.description: Only `name` is accepted. `id`, `balance` and `created_at` are system-generated.

get.summary: Get the current balance of an account

post.summary: Add a credit or debit transaction
post.description: Atomically appends a ledger entry and updates the balance. `reference_id` makes the call idempotent per account: replaying it returns 409 and changes nothing.

amount.description: Amount in major currency units (e.g. 150.75), at most 2 decimal places

reference_id.description: Client-supplied idempotency key, unique per account

balance_after.description: Account balance immediately after this entry

transfer_id.description: Set when the entry is one leg of a transfer

get.description: Latest first (by `created_at`). Supports `type` filter and `page`/`limit` pagination.
